lines.text: Why have You rejected us forever, O God?
against the sheep of Your pasture?
and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance—
Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins,
to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed.
Your foes have roared within Your meeting place;
they have unfurled their banners as signs,
like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees
and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.
They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground;
they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name.

pictures.scene: Jozef Israëls, 'Alleen op de wereld' — the old man left sitting alone by the empty bed with his head in his hand, a Maskil of Asaph, why have You rejected us forever O God
pictures.name: pd_israels_alleen_op_de_wereld

pictures.scene: Balthasar Paul Ommeganck, Landschap met schapen en een hooiwagen — the flock lying down in the open pasture with the hay cart behind them, why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture
pictures.name: pd_ommeganck_schapen_hooiwagen

pictures.scene: Alphonse Mucha, Kázání mistra Jana Husa v kapli Betlémské — the whole congregation packed into the chapel to hear the preaching, remember Your congregation which You purchased long ago
pictures.name: pd_mucha_kazani_husa_betlemske

pictures.scene: Théodore Frère, Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives — the city lying along its ridge seen across the valley in the evening light, and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance, Mount Zion where You dwell
pictures.name: pd_frere_jerusalem_mount_of_olives

pictures.scene: Louis Daguerre, The Ruins of Holyrood Chapel — the roofless chapel with its windows open to the sky and the floor full of rubble, turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins, to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed
pictures.name: pd_daguerre_holyrood_chapel_ruins

pictures.scene: Hendrick Cornelisz Vroom, Battle of Haarlemmermeer — the ships crowded together on the water with their flags and pennants run up, Your foes have roared within Your meeting place, they have unfurled their banners as signs
pictures.name: pd_vroom_haarlemmermeer

pictures.scene: Hubert Robert, Démolition de l'Eglise Saint-Jean-en-Grève — the workmen up on the walls of the church swinging at the stonework and pulling it down, like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks
pictures.name: pd_robert_demolition_saint_jean

pictures.scene: Jan Abrahamsz Beerstraaten, De puinhopen van het Oude Stadhuis te Amsterdam na de brand van 7 juli 1652 — the burnt-out shell of the great building still smoking in the snow, they have burned Your sanctuary to the ground, they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name
pictures.name: pd_beerstraaten_puinhopen_stadhuis
